an10.102:1.1: sattime bhikkhave bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā tisso vijjā paripūrenti.
an10.102:1.3: satisambojjhaṅgo, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo, viriyasambojjhaṅgo, pītisambojjhaṅgo, passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo,
an10.102:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave sattabojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā tisso vijjā paripūrenti.
an10.102:1.6: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
an10.102:1.7: seyyathīdaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
an10.102:1.8: dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena …pe… yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
an10.102:1.10: ime kho bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā imā tisso vijjā paripūrentī
